hostParameters.label: Instrument
hostParameters.note: Host-automatable SFZ selection (issue #20). The choice list is machine-specific — ["(keep current)"] followed by every installed SFZ instrument — so the names are NOT listed here; the contract for mapping a name to a value is in instrumentSelect below.

hostParameters.label: Library Ready
hostParameters.note: Readiness signal (sapporchestra #2, mirrors sappkeys v0.8.0). 1 = every pending instrument load has landed and the selected slot holds what it was told to hold; 0 = a load owns the window. A headless host polls this instead of guessing a settle time. Never saved or restored with host state.

instrumentSelect.samplesRoot: the shared Sapp 'samplesRoot' setting (SampleLibraries.settings, default ~/Samples); env SAPP_SFZ_ROOT overrides. CLI: `sapporchestra sfz-index [--root DIR] [--rescan]` prints the exact entry/choice/normalized table.
instrumentSelect.order: entries[] are sorted case-insensitively by label (ASCII; ties by exact label, then path). The plugin re-sorts on load, so file order always equals choice order — never assume any other ordering.
instrumentSelect.nameToIndex: find the label in entries[] (label = path relative to the root, '/'-separated, without '.sfz'); its 0-based position i selects choice k = i + 1. Choice 0 = '(keep current)'. Normalized value for a host parameter write = k / count (the choice list has count + 1 items).
instrumentSelect.programChange: MIDI bank-select + program change also selects: entry = ((CC0 << 7) | CC32) * 128 + program. Per-MIDI-channel — the entry loads into that channel's slot (16-slot multitimbral).
instrumentSelect.state: the chosen SFZ persists in host state BY ABSOLUTE PATH, not by index (indices shift when the library changes); a missing file at restore falls back to the built-in sound.
instrumentSelect.rescan: the choice list is fixed per plugin instantiation (JUCE cannot grow a choice list live); after adding libraries run `sapporchestra sfz-index --rescan` (or delete the index) — the new list appears on the NEXT instantiation.
instrumentSelect.note: presets[] stays empty on purpose: the 500+ installed SFZ names are machine-specific, so this manifest carries the enumeration contract instead of a hardcoded list.
